explication: SPIRE establishes workload identity through a server–agent trust system, then serves issued SPIFFE identities and trust bundles to workloads and integrations. The main workflow is node attestation and agent synchronization, followed by workload attestation and delivery of X.509 or JWT SVIDs through the Workload API. The README also documents Envoy SDS, federation, and bundle distribution. The tree and excerpts establish the principal subsystems; some detailed runtime wiring is inferred only where the README explicitly describes the capability.
